name: Rock_Armor
display_fullname: CircleOfThorns Circle Thorn Caster Seismic Rock Armor
display_help: The Caster's skin becomes stone while this power is active. Rock Armor protects the Caster from Smashing and Lethal attacks. They are less likely to land and affect the Caster. Rock Armor also grants you resistance to Fire, Cold, and Defense DeBuffs.
display_short_help: Toggle: Self +DEF(Smash, Lethal), +Res(Fire, Cold, DeBuff DEF)
